description: Source code for MPU6050 sensor trigger handling in Zephyr OS, including interrupt setup, callback handling, and thread management.

methods.name: mpu6050_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures the MPU6050 data ready trigger and handler.

methods.name: mpu6050_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO interrupt callback that disables further interrupts and signals thread or work.

methods.name: mpu6050_thread_cb
methods.description: Invokes the data ready handler and re-enables the interrupt.

methods.name: mpu6050_thread
methods.description: Thread function that waits on semaphore and calls callback.

methods.name: mpu6050_work_cb
methods.description: Work handler that calls thread callback.

methods.name: mpu6050_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO interrupt for MPU6050 and sets up callback and thread/work.
